description.value: A voxel-based whole-brain SPECT study examined correlations between eating-abnormality subscales and regional cerebral blood flow in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia and semantic variant primary progressive aphasia.

spans.text: In this study, we aimed to investigate the correlation between eating abnormalities and rCBF in bvFTD and svPPA patients using SPECT with voxel-based whole-brain quantitative analysis.

description.value: A clinical observational study of patients with bvFTD and svPPA recruited from memory disorder clinics.

spans.text: Forty-seven subjects (43 with bvFTD, 29 with svPPA) were recruited from memory disorder clinics of China-Japan Friendship Hospital between 2013 and 2018.
